messages.text: Ahmedabad Weather Intelligence: Deep moisture inflow from the Northeast Arabian Sea is driving convective cloud bands inland. Expected precipitation probability is 78% with moderate to heavy spells during late afternoon.

personaAdvisory.title: CITIZEN MOBILITY ADVISORY
personaAdvisory.recommendation: Rain is likely tomorrow evening in Ahmedabad after 4:00 PM. Peak intensity expected between 5:00 PM and 7:30 PM. Carry rain protection and consider scheduling outdoor commutes or market trips prior to late afternoon.

factors.title: 78% Precipitation Probability
factors.detail: Ensemble agreement across ECMWF, GFS, and WRF 3km high-resolution runs confirms heavy convective moisture convergence.

factors.title: Increasing Wind & Squall Dynamics
factors.detail: Surface winds accelerating from 14 km/h to gust peaks of 42 km/h during convective downdrafts.

factors.title: Atmospheric Instability (CAPE > 2,400 J/kg)
factors.detail: High thermal lapse rates and Gulf of Khambhat moisture flux creating strong vertical thunderstorm updrafts.

factors.title: Official Multi-Agency Cross-Check
factors.detail: IMD Doppler Radar Bhuj/Ahmedabad reflectivity > 45 dBZ verified against INSAT-3DR infrared sounders.

whyThisRisk.synopticSource: IMD Coastal Radar Network & AERIS Rapid Warning System
